title: Interpretation of Scripture
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: Interpretation of Scripture is the faithful effort to understand God’s Word according to its context, meaning, purpose, and place in the whole counsel of God. Scripture must be handled humbly, prayerfully, and truthfully.
summary: Interpretation of Scripture is the faithful effort to understand God’s Word according to its context, meaning, purpose, and place in the whole counsel of God. Scripture must be handled humbly, prayerfully, and truthfully.
christFocus: Jesus interpreted Scripture as God’s truthful Word and showed that it points to Him and His saving work. Faithful interpretation does not use Scripture for self-serving purposes, but leads believers to Christ, truth, repentance, and obedience.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
God’s Word must be understood rightly. The goal of interpretation is not to make Scripture say what people want, but to receive what God has actually spoken. This requires humility, context, prayer, careful reading, and submission to the truth.

Faithful interpretation pays attention to words, sentences, passages, books, historical setting, literary form, and the whole message of Scripture. A verse should not be ripped from context to support pride, fear, manipulation, false teaching, or personal preference.

Scripture interprets Scripture. Clearer passages help guide difficult ones, and the whole Bible must be read in light of God’s redemptive purpose fulfilled in Christ. This protects believers from careless speculation and distorted teaching.

Some parts of Scripture are harder to understand, and believers must handle them with patience and humility. Difficulty is not permission to twist the Word. Teachers especially must rightly handle Scripture because misuse of God’s Word can harm souls.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many people have been wounded by Scripture being twisted, misused, or weaponized. Others have been led into error because a verse was isolated from its meaning. Bad interpretation can produce fear, pride, confusion, legalism, false hope, or spiritual abuse.

Faithful interpretation protects the church and nourishes believers. It allows Scripture to correct us instead of letting us control Scripture. It also helps ordinary believers grow in confidence that God’s Word can be understood, trusted, and lived.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Approach Scripture as a humble learner, not a master over the text. Read carefully, consider context, compare Scripture with Scripture, pray for understanding, and be willing to be corrected. When teaching others, do not use God’s Word to impress, control, or win arguments; handle it faithfully so people are led toward Christ.
